subject: Project update and pricing clarification
text:
Since this is our first project together, I wanted to send a quick project update while I sort out a few small details from the last brief. The draft outline for the new landing page is now complete, and I have started laying out the first three sections based on the existing materials. The headline block, feature summary, and short testimonial area are all in place, but I need one clarification before moving further. Your notes mentioned that the pricing section should feel clear and direct, then the earlier message asked for the same section to include several subtle comparisons between plans. I can do either approach, but I do not want to build a layout that later needs major changes. If you could confirm whether the priority is simplicity, detailed comparison, or a balanced version with limited comparisons, I can adjust without slowing the schedule.

The rest is proceeding as planned. The copy draft is at the stage where it can be reviewed for tone, not just basic wording, and the image placeholders now reflect the structure we discussed. I also made a small improvement to the mobile menu so it behaves the same across two test devices. My next step is to complete the remaining sections once the pricing question is settled. If you prefer, I can prepare a short alternative version for review instead of changing the main layout immediately. That may save time if your team is still deciding. I will continue on the supporting pages while I wait for that clarification, so we do not lose momentum.

Thanks,
